programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death-a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the war's front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert history's tragedy.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: The Mad Monk (1993)
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition – he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Rodney the Hero Club Shed

When Lula and Luis want a clubhouse for the Squasher Fan Club, TZG secretly help fix up the shed in Luis’ backyard.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - It Takes a Zenko What a Racket
programme.desc: When various townsfolk report having lost soft belongings, TZG secretly investigates to discover thieving pigeon Yolanda had been building a nest for baby gophers. When Ian’s lucky badminton racket goes missing, TZG secretly finds and returns it in time for a rematch against his toughest opponent.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Ready Set Race!
programme.desc: On the eve of the annual Maywood soapbox derby, a sudden rainstorm soaks Olivia cardboard car and completely ruins it. Never one to throw in the towel, Olivia turns Perry’s doghouse into a racecar and triumphantly wins the race – with Perry as her copilot!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Butterfly Safar
programme.desc: When a beautiful butterfly emerges from the chrysalis in Ian’s butterfly terrarium, Olivia begs him to let her take it to school for Show & Tell. He finally agrees, but while showing and telling, the butterfly escapes and flies away! Olivia, donning a flower-shaped balloon hat, sets out to find it.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Joy!
programme.desc: The annual town dance competition is coming up, and Olivia is determined to put an end to the reigning champs’ (“The Prancer Dancers”) winning streak. With some help from Grandma, she forms her own rag-tag dance troupe, and learns a thing or two about dancing for the pure joy of it!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - The Mighty Five
programme.desc: After Olivia and Dad spend an afternoon reading superhero comic books, a toy of William’s suddenly goes missing! Could it be the evil doings of some evil super villain? To get William’s toy back, Olivia recruits her friends to form her own crimesolving, superhero team!

programme.desc: When Lucky and the PALs arrive home from the circus, they find that Maricela and her new bicycle have become the star attraction in Miradero

programme.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - Iron Ted Weekend
programme.desc: King Julien and team discover a trapped Crimson and must team up to defeat a beast; Mort tries to rally his fellow lemurs but they are losing hope

programme.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - Bridge On The River Mort
programme.desc: King Julien decides to get his kingdom back; Sage and Clover train with Sage's Master; Mort rallies everyone to build an escape tunnel

programme.title: All Hail King Julien: Exiled S3 - Raiders Of The Lord Shark
programme.desc: King Julien's submarine sinks in the ocean; Clover &amp; Sage go on quests to test their patience and rage; Mort leads an escape but a spy is in the midst

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - The Fandom Menace Moby Dot
programme.desc: Lotta enters a contest to win an empanada date that turns out to be a scam. Dot desperately pursues a rare albino hornet terrorizing the park.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - The Cheer Hunter Dot's Entertainment
programme.desc: Zoe invites Lotta to join her cheer squad and Audrey gets jealous Dot becomes obsessed with making people laugh after telling her first joke

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Crabcavator
programme.desc: The Dinotrux go aquatic when they learn that the part they need to fix Click-Clack can only be found at the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Ankylodump Games
programme.desc: Ton-Ton wants to live out his dream of participating in the Ankylodump Games. But doing so could put him and the other Trux in danger.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S3 - Flock The Boat
programme.desc: When the pirates show up in San Lorenzo with Tranche trying to find a kidnapped Captain Alonso, Puss and Tranche try to “out hero” each other

programme.title: The Adventures Of Puss In Boots S3 - All Hail, Puss!
programme.desc: With the earthquakes in San Lorenzo becoming unmanageable, Puss turns to the sky gods, who give him mighty powers

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - All Paws on Deck Bonestand and Deliver
programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paw’s anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. \ Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawston’s 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Ring My Bell First Mate Casper
programme.desc: Ring My Bell When Casper encourages Quasi to go on strike from his thankless job as chore boy, Alder and Dash make Casper take his place. First Mate Casper When Cappy needs a first mate, Casper's the only one who's up to the challenge.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Power Outage Part 1 + 2
programme.desc: Power Outage – Part 1: A Powerful Foe When Scare School falls victim to the Baccora, Kibosh encourages the students to work together, setting booby-traps and building defences. Power Outage – Part 2: Razznik's Revenge Creature by creature, the evil entity, Baccora, robs Scare School of its powers and locks them into a magical cleptor.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Welcome to Harmony Harbor
programme.desc: Ari moves in to Harmony Harbor, but notices something strange involving a group of kids, a Noodle Truck chef and her pet squirrel. After Ari discovers the secret of Team Zenko Go, he asks to join the crew. But first he must learn the importance of teamwork.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Delivery Disaster Slippery Business
programme.desc: When Donna's delivery truck breaks down, it's up to the crew to help Donna continue delivering packages to Harmony Harbor's residents. When the crew takes on a mission to rescue a lost pet, Ellie must face her fears in order to help save the day.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Hoedown Hero
programme.desc: Olivia’s class is learning to how to square-dance, and Olivia is thrilled. She’s less thrilled, however, to be partnered with clumsy Harold Hockenberry, who seems to have two left feet. But when Olivia learns what a skilled gardener Harold is, she incorporates gardening into their square-dance, with fabulous results!

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Staycation
programme.desc: Everyone is in Olivia’s family is disappointed when their cruise is cancelled after Ian breaks out in a strange rash. Nevertheless, Olivia is determined to show her family a good time. With an inflatable pirate ship bounce house, Olivia takes her family and friends on the backyard cruise of their lives.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Charmed Life
programme.desc: Olivia finds the perfect birthday present for Francine in a box of cereal – a pink charm bracelet! But when it accidentally falls down the drain, Olivia has to scramble to find an alternative: using trinkets that recall some of their favorite memories together, Olivia makes her own charm bracelet for a delighted Francine.

programme.title: Olivia S2 - Snowlady
programme.desc: Olivia is thrilled when she’s chosen to build the mascot snowman –or in her case, snowlady – for the annual Maywood winter festival. She’s determined to build the biggest snowman anybody’s ever seen! But when all the snow melts away, Olivia has to build her snowlady out of something else: cotton candy!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - The Last Dance Mummy's Boy
programme.desc: The Last Dance ‐ The annual school dance, the Monster Mash, is approaching and Mantha is really nervous because she hasn’t got anything to wear. Plus she’s finally going to meet with Frankie, her pen pal, who’s coming to attend to the special event. She puts on a pair of magical shoes that won't come off and won't let her feet stop moving — dancing here, kicking people’s butts there — Mantha's in trouble! Casper and Ra will have to help her discover the mystery behind the shoes before the Monste

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S2 - To Catch A Monster No Bones About It
programme.desc: To Catch A Monster - Everybody's disappearing one by one at Scare School and Casper is getting increasingly worried.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Banana Bread Burglar Finding Meow Meow
programme.desc: When the banana bread Harper leaves out for Eden is stolen, the Dew Drops create a sting operation to catch the thief. When Captain Meow Meow gets a splinter in his paw and hears the word "vet," he flees. Now it's up to the Dew Drops to find Captain Meow Meow and get that splinter out.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Catch that Drone The Fairy of the Teeth
programme.desc: When Harper's drone flies away it’s up to the Dew Drops to get it back. And while Eden wishes she could fly like a drone, she learns that she can do great things with or without wings. When Dylan loses his first tooth the Dew Drops learn that the Tooth Fairy will be coming and Athena tries so hard to make a good impression that she almost ruins Dylan's first lost tooth experience.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Little Sisters Tricky Treasure
programme.desc: Kelp and Pixie forget about their little sisters and their plans to hang out. Scallop goes to Unicorn Land and meets Juniper. They play and become friends. The unicorns are eager to play with a new mystery item that washes up on the beach, but what is it? While the other unicorns come up with imaginative ideas of what it could be, Pixie is determined to find out exactly what it is.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Crabby Spe-shell
programme.desc: When Pixie’s pet crab goes into a cave, Kelp uses his knowledge of crabs under the sea to coax him out using dance and rhythm. Scallop’s special shell is broken, but Kelp transforms the broken bits into something even more special.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Hot, Hot, Hot
programme.desc: Aggro is embarrassed about big changes she's going through. And when she gets stuck in a volcano, the Rescue Riders seek help from ... Magnus?

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Hot, Hot, Hot
programme.desc: When a mama Ironclaw dragon gets caught high on a mountain with a broken wing, Hannahr the blacksmith has to confront her fear of heights to help out.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ's Glow Ride
programme.desc: Gabby receives a special nighttime delivery, unboxing a glow-in-the-dark train engine. However, she realizes that she's missing the other three train cars to complete the whole train. The Gabby Cats help Gabby build the other three glow-in-the-dark train cars by creating shapes through interactivemusical games. In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, DJ Catnip sings a song.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Rainy Day Banana
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - The Lone Park Ranger
programme.desc: When Ranger Hoof invites Marty on a Junior Ranger night trot in Central Park, Marty is determined to prove he's got what it takes to do the job- but when Alex tags along for the ride, Marty learns that "what it takes" is a whole lot of teamwork.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - The Year of The Lion
programme.desc: During the Lunar New Year festival, Alex is bummed to learn that there's no Year of the Lion. Determined to be somebody important, he sets out to become the star of the festival by taking on the role of the Dragon- but he eventually learns that every role has importance, and realizes the costume that fits him best is his own fur.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Primetime Wendi Powers A Giant Problem
programme.desc: When Archibald accidentally becomes Wendi Powers’ camera operator, they team up to crack the story on Crackridge’s serial prankster. While Archibald is babysitting, toddler Lola gets her hands on the Sizematron and accidentally bigifies herself to the size of a building!

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing Is Here! S2 - Earl Tappercorn Queen Bea
programme.desc: When Archibald watches an asteroid make impact, he soon discovers that it was actually a spacecraft containing an alien. As the authorities close in, it’s up to Archibald to get the weary traveler back to his home planet. When Archibald invites Bea’s extended family to visit, he makes a shocking discovery….Bea is a princess!

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - The Legends of the Power Gems: Chapter Four
programme.desc: With all three elemental power gems in hand, Fearless Leader sets out to take over the world. But with every use of the gems, the world becomes more unstable, and they’re heading toward certain destruction

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Amazamoose and Squirrel Wonder: Chapter One
programme.desc: Every year, the world turns to Frostbite Falls’ beloved cat Frostbite Frannie to declare the first day of summer vacation. When Frannie sees her tail, vacations can begin!

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - Monkey Planet
programme.desc: King Julien declares that lemurs will land on the moon and seeks help from a former astronaut: Stanislav, the Russian Space Monkey.

programme.title: All Hail King Julien S1 - True Bromance
programme.desc: When King Julien discovers that Maurice is moonlighting as adviser to another king, the two best friends break up.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Inside Jokings It's A Jungle In There
programme.desc: Tip and Oh make their first inside joke and Oh shares it with everyone; Tip watches Oh's new alien plant while he's gone and breeds a catastrophe.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Dang You Saved My Life Boovsland Noir
programme.desc: Sharzod hates feeling indebted to Tip after being rescued and tries to get "even"; Police King Kyle must solve the case of Sharzod's missing mojo.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Poison Ravine
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Master Key
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Last Dumont
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents—her mom. And somehow, Po finds himself in a chess tournament against the Queen of Englan

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Snack of Dawn
programme.desc: Dawn is bummed when an injury prevents her from joining the Croods and Bettermans to a trip to Fizzy Falls, but when Thunk recruits her on his quest for an ancient stash of legendary snacks, Dawn can't resist joining the treasure hunt.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - Fam Farm Fun Fest
programme.desc: Believing he doesn't fit in on the farm, Chunky (aided by the other pets) leaves home to follow the distant call of another death cat. The kids set off to bring him back home. Note: Gran narrates the story.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S2 - It's an Under-ful Life
programme.desc: "(Happens concurrent with events of previous episode) Grug accidentally reveals a subterranean cave beneath the treehouse. When Phil can't convince Hope, Grug, and Ugga that the treehouse is more impressive than the new cave, he sets out to destroy the cave."

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Rafaela’s Raf-venge
programme.desc: The team realizes that they’re being led on a wild goose chase and that the person behind it all must be the one and only Rafaela! She’s broken out of prison and is now causing havoc in Berlin using the dangerous stolen spy tech – which makes her more formidable that ever before.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Fun on the Autobahn
programme.desc: The search for the Incineration Day tech continues and Frostee thinks he’s finally figured out who’s behind the whole thing: his little sister, Sissy! Unfortunately, his theory is quickly debunked when Sissy and his moms are kidnapped by the actual bad guys – culminating in an epic race down the Autobahn to save Frostee’s family!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S2 - Detonation
programme.desc: Cisco’s been kidnapped! The team scrambles to get him back, but Tony and Echo disagree on the best plan of action.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Buffalord Soldier
programme.desc: Astrid comes down with the Odin's Revenge flu and the Riders must search for the cure by finding a nearly extinct Buffalord dragon before Viggo does.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - A Grim Retreat
programme.desc: The Riders head to a tropical island for fun in the sun, not realizing it's infested with Grimora Leeches which drives their dragons to turn on them.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - To Heather Or Not To Heather
programme.desc: When Heather and Windshear land on Dragon's Edge to join the Dragon Rider crew, they quickly discover that Windshear doesn't play well with others.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Turf War
programme.desc: It's a turf war when Bounce House Bruiser Baby encroaches on Delivery Baby's tricycle park! Tina attempts to befriend Bruiser in order to woo her back to the bounce house, but naughty behavior is the only language Bruiser understands. Determined to win this kid over, Tina ends up going rogue as a trike hoodlum, and her own field team is forced to reign her in.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Rough Ride
programme.desc: The PALs join AI and Javier on a mustang drive, but when Javier gets injured, it’s up to Lucky and Spirit to get him to safety

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Ghostly Gotcha!
programme.desc: When Snips claims not to be afraid of ghosts, the PALs decide to give him a fun Halloween scare he’ll never forget!

programme.title: 生活智多星第1872集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－鬱方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，瞭解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 做陣來舞弄第2集
programme.desc: 拍攝團隊花費多年跑遍全台各大小廟宇，發現台灣廟宇可見面向相當廣泛，不僅是民眾的信仰中心，還兼具民俗技藝、休閒、藝術…等功能，透過影片可以看見信徒對神明的感恩之心、祭典慶典時熱鬧的陣頭凝聚了當地的力量。

programme.title: 生活快易通第229集
programme.desc: 節目邀請到大家熟悉的「萬人美老師」－郭昱晴擔任主持人。以系列為節目核心，邀請在相同體系內，受到推崇的精英人士，分享其堅守追求專業的精神與受挫不懈的毅力。並且將依照不同專業，結合生活觀點，推出相符的小單元。內容兼具權威與風趣，不僅拉近觀眾與來賓距離，也從中看到來賓不為人知的另一面。如節目中熱血仁醫系列，除了分享醫生在白色巨塔中奮鬥的故事之外，也會依其專業，在預防醫學的概念下，加入醫療科技新資訊及獨門養生撇步等小單元。

programme.title: 梵音清流第2集
programme.desc: 此音只應天上有，人間哪得幾回聞。」「梵唄」就是清淨之意，除了耳根享受之外，最主要的仍在心靈的清淨，歌詠時還伴以管、弦或敲擊樂器，普及佛教教義。

programme.title: 我的學校有夠酷第12集
programme.desc: 最有趣的學校課程單元探索台灣最酷特色小學， 認識不一樣的學校課程。發掘全台各小學充滿魅力且迷人的特色教學孩子化身為小老師、小職人、小導覽員，分享感受、展現自信與活力主持人沉浸式體驗校園酷趣事及不同面向學習環境，瞭解在地特色民情透過鏡頭，一起跟著孩子們探索台灣的多元文化吧！

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1873集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－鬱方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，瞭解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 幸福食堂第355集
programme.desc: 由人氣主持人攜手多位蔬食名廚，現場烹調精緻美味的蔬食餐點，讓您大飽眼福，也大飽口福。

programme.title: 我的學校有夠酷第13集
programme.desc: 最有趣的學校課程單元探索台灣最酷特色小學， 認識不一樣的學校課程。發掘全台各小學充滿魅力且迷人的特色教學孩子化身為小老師、小職人、小導覽員，分享感受、展現自信與活力主持人沉浸式體驗校園酷趣事及不同面向學習環境，瞭解在地特色民情透過鏡頭，一起跟著孩子們探索台灣的多元文化吧！

programme.title: 人間佛學院第92集
programme.desc: 人間佛學院希望能帶領觀眾研習佛學義理，深入經藏智慧的法門，將人間佛教的理念，徹底落實在我們日常生活當中，且聽人間佛教的修行者深入淺出地帶您遨遊浩瀚佛法。

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第349集
programme.desc: 音樂人田定豐除了跨足文創和攝影，斜槓有成的他將攜手人間衛視，開一個電視新節目──「藝次元宇宙」，邀請藝術領域的意見領袖分享人生故事。

programme.title: 歡樂家長群第2集
programme.desc: 編劇劉向上日常時間安排相對自由，在家裡負責兒子果寧、女兒果寶的教育陪護，妻子戴靜選擇在薪酬較高的外地公司打拼。劉向上一家因為孩子開學而與朋友、鄰居及其他學生家長成為群友，面對各種突發狀況的新手家長們和鬼馬精靈的孩子們共同迎接教育新課堂、人生新起點的故事。

programme.desc: 說趣事․悟禪理․善能量以生動易懂的品德道理為主旨，精采呈現一部老少皆宜、有趣感人的禪理動畫作品。《布袋小和尚》是中國大陸首部為孩子原創製作的禪意動畫片。《布袋小和尚》以彌勒佛化身的布袋和尚為原型，以奉化雪竇寺為故事發生地，講述一個逍遙自在、無拘無束、笑口常開的大肚彌勒小和尚，和他的夥伴小布袋、吉祥鳥，被委以修建廟宇的重任。在重建廟宇的過程中，布袋小和尚遇到了各種稀奇古怪、啼笑皆非的事情，小和尚運用他的聰明才智和神奇布袋，揚善懲惡，幫助百姓克服困難，用愛心溫暖人間。劇情輕鬆有趣又感人，將中華傳統美德融入其中，使得教育與娛樂相結合，教導少年兒童做好事、說好話、存好心等行為道德，在笑中體會道德的光芒

programme.title: 人間佛學院第93集

programme.title: 藝次元宇宙第272集

programme.title: 歡樂家長群第3集
programme.desc: 編劇劉向上日常時間安排相對自由，在家裡負責兒子果寧、女兒果寶的教育陪護，妻子戴靜選擇在薪酬較高的外地公司打拼。劉向上一家因為孩子開學而與朋友、鄰居及其他學生家長成為群友，面對各種突發狀況的新手家長們和鬼馬精靈的孩子們共同迎接教育新課堂、人生新起點的故事。

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第19集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉裡衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 熱海戀歌第20集
programme.desc: 父母親早逝的英雄，從小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次鄉裡衝突，英雄和換帖兄弟添財離家北上，進入溫泉鄉~北投，當起限時專送的機車小弟。在北投，他遇見今生唯一的摯愛秀秀。擁有天生音樂才華的他，最初學習各種樂器只是為了討秀秀歡心，最後卻因此成為名揚北投的「春風」那卡西樂團樂手。可惜兩人純真的戀情，卻遭秀秀的養父所反對，英雄卻不放棄；縱使在得知秀秀已與日本商人白原訂婚之後，英雄仍不死心，繼續穿梭在溫泉鄉崎嶇的巷道與繁華的酒宴間，彈著為秀秀所譜寫的未完成歌曲，無畏地向全世界宣誓，他要傾盡一生的光陰來愛秀秀…。在秀秀與白元的婚禮上，英雄衝到美川閣，想帶秀秀遠走高飛！畢竟深愛著英雄的秀秀，身著婚紗、不顧一切坐上他

programme.title: 幸福的起點第11集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第25集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第209集
programme.desc:
什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？
『志為人醫守護愛』帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親、 以病為師的堅持、病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人。

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道。除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注、培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大愛真健康第1176集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身、增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實。 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三~五分鐘時間，跟著「大愛真健康」做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕、愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 幸福的起點第11集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 行動現場第567集
programme.desc:
愛，不漏接，做，就對了！
台灣社會貧富懸殊、強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同、人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規、人力、經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口。慈濟志工為數甚眾，是台灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散佈各鄉鎮村裡，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落。
我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接、需要幫助的人。

programme.title: 靜思妙蓮華第238集
programme.desc: 每天清晨靜思精舍早課後， 證嚴上人親選重要佛經講解，輔以社會現況、人間故事做開示，將兩千五百年前的 佛陀說法，與二十一世紀世間法相呼應。

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第54集
programme.desc: 「風月同天」此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：「山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣。」意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫、共度風雨。影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影—以行動，讓愛無國界。這，就是慈濟——一個由無數人的「小善」匯聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大愛學漢醫第242集
programme.desc: 讓世界看懂中醫，打破中醫的框架迷思，發揮預防重於治療的優點，讓台灣走向樂活社會。

programme.title: 人間菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分鐘， 證嚴上人以佛心應世事，結合台灣社會脈動、全球趨勢，從後山看世界。

programme.title: 幸福的起點第12集
programme.desc: 林雅美從小活潑聰明，林父身體不好，雅美從十歲開始學做生意，很快地展現她做生意的天賦，雅美是米行的超級業務員，同時也是四位妹妹的好大姊，不管有什麼事情，天塌下來，總有大姊撐著。 雅美能幹又漂亮，亭亭玉立正是適婚年紀，不過碾米廠家業全仰賴雅美，雅美根本無意出嫁。林父林母緊張，就像米一樣，老米在市場上是沒有競爭力的。父母積極地為雅美安排相親，雅美體貼父母的心意，答應了相親。不過雅美有個但書，她無論如何不要嫁給做生意的人，她已經厭倦了做生意的忙碌，如果真要進入婚姻，她只想要找一個老老實實的上班族。

programme.title: 大愛醫生館第6921集
programme.desc: 不斷汲取新知，已是現代人必備的條件，對於人文精神的掌握，往往顯得貧乏。大愛醫生館藉由醫師專業知識加上俯拾即是的美感經驗與與回歸人文思想的本懷，期望幫助忙碌的現代人多關心自己與周遭人的身心健康，為醫療節目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 愛的人生路第25集
programme.desc: 餘樹木和老婆元美生了五個女兒，年過四十仍無子嗣，為了傳承香火，元美安排丈夫娶了二房綉蘭。綉蘭不負所望生下天助，原以為家庭從此圓滿和樂，未料元美早逝，大女兒阿雪和二媽綉蘭個性差異，經常為生活瑣事爭執，家庭失和，令天助十分痛苦。 餘家這本難唸的經，要怎麼轉變為幸福經，共走愛的人生路？

programme.title: 仁心慧語第741集
programme.desc: 真正的智慧來自於內心，由內心啟悟的智慧也最真實。證嚴 上人說：「做該做的事就是智慧，做不該做的事就是愚痴。」十個問題、十個解方，都是言者生命經驗的體現，透過名人的智慧哲理，足以啟迪人心，振聾發瞶，重新思考人生的價值。

programme.title: 看美善學美善美善劇場第724集
programme.desc: 京都富商的二女兒今井阿淺(波琉飾)在大阪創立礦碳公司、銀行、生命保險公司等一系列活動，並竭盡全力設立日本第一所女子大學的故事。阿淺的人物原型是被稱為明治時代女中豪傑的實業家廣岡淺子。這是晨間劇故事首次從幕府末代拉開序幕，引發熱議。同時出演的還有宮崎葵、寺島忍、玉木宏等演員。

什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間、在手術室、在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？

programme.title: 風月同天-5分30秒版第7集

programme.title: MIT台灣誌第623集
programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陸尋奇第2120集

programme.desc: 《MIT台灣誌》是為台灣探訪與見證前人留下歷史足跡，為台灣這塊土地留下一段完整紀錄，並參照資料照片與麥覺明口頭解說，令觀眾可以拼湊出當年歷史。在每段廣告之前，《MIT台灣誌》會出現一則專題解說，是《MIT台灣誌》另一項特色。《MIT台灣誌》除富有歷史文化探訪紀錄外，在探訪路途上會不斷探究與發現值得紀錄之事，有：生態介紹、地質變化、新物種發現、辨認動植物、山嶽特色與氣候、術語解說、人文風情寫實…等，這也見證了台灣前古後今、探史溯源的多元性紀錄，是一部具有生態教學、文化品味、社會動態與價值變化的詮釋，深深結合自台灣有開發歷史以來，歷經滄海桑田的歲月與戰爭留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 社會NOW什麼第19集
programme.desc: 超精彩的社會現象、社會觀察以及社會檔案內幕分析都在社會NOW什麼！

programme.title: 霹靂俠影之轟霆劍海錄第67集
programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑後，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 天子傳奇第26集

programme.desc: 神州動盪，武林危難，森獄大舉入侵，逆海崇帆滅亡，黑海森獄崛起，玄囂太子領導眾多強將，一舉攻陷武林。同為皇儲，玄滅太子也伺機而出，與玄囂一爭苦境版圖，要將森獄版圖擴張至苦境，完成個人霸業，以便未來繼承閻王之位。道門六傑挺身而出，倦收天與銀驃當家等攜手抵抗，唯慕崢嶸私心自用，導致無辜傷亡，最終遭受制裁惡有惡報。而玄滅也在過程中敗亡，留下玄囂太子，延續葬天關魔城擴張的計畫，最終對上倦收天與銀驃當家。森獄潛伏的勢力崛起，大太子玄臏協同蛻變黑後，兩人暗中關注著玄囂太子的一切行為，伺機而作。而一生執著於劍道的玄同，也因為論劍海的評劍會，踏入苦 境，追尋屬於自己的劍道。究竟是誰的劍？能給予惋紅曲追尋的答案。

programme.title: 從零開始第8集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦於經歷失業、破產或陷入人生低谷的小人物，講述由黃晶玲等人組成的團隊如何以非一般的手法與官方、業務協助破產人士克服挑戰、重新出發。

programme.title: 少年白馬醉春風第37集
programme.desc: 故事講述在江湖中，顧家與晏家兩大勢力爭奪魁首，而此時，一位年輕的酒肆老闆白東君與江湖浪客司空長風捲入其中，與各方勢力展開鬥爭，展現熱血少年們的江湖冒險與成長。

programme.title: 霹靂兵烽決之碧血玄黃第5集
programme.desc: 在香六牙、西窗月、少陽君等人聯手弭平地獄鳥、暗劫災禍之際，昔時五巔之戰的殘禍仍未靖平，新一波的災劫悄然孳生。

programme.title: 真人圖書館第2集
programme.desc: 邀請心智障礙者擔任講師分享他(她)們自己的生命經驗，在每一集故事中可以聽到每個人不同的選擇與不同的決定。

programme.title: 從零開始第8集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦於經歷失業、破產或陷入人生低谷的小人物，講述由黃晶玲等人組成的團隊如何以非一般的手法與官方、業務協助破產人士克服挑戰、重新出發。

programme.title: 第一世家第26集
programme.desc: 以賴水泉家庭三位子女的婚姻及家族興衰史為情節重心，表現該家族如何與鄉裡共存共榮，並描繪出台灣五十年來的成長過程及社會融合的軌跡。

programme.title: 花甲少年趣旅行第6集
programme.desc: 2位花甲明星＋2位少年偶像，跨齡差距的結伴青春旅行，走訪在地文化行銷台灣，世代差異的旅遊個性激盪出充滿意外性的實境自助旅行。當稚嫩少年遇上犀利花甲，會擦出什麼火花呢?這是一段花甲老熟肉與少年小鮮肉們，跨越大齡差距，結伴而行的明星青春旅行。到底小鮮肉們想什麼？而老熟肉們又會怎麼玩？透過世代差異，激盪出觀眾意想不到的旅行火花！全台唯一全明星跨世代旅遊實境節目，紀錄跨世代的藝人們難忘的友情之旅！從陌生到熟悉！ 從畏懼到麻吉！讓小鮮肉成長！讓老熟肉回春！不囉唆！現在出發吧～

programme.title: 阿叔第26集
programme.desc: 劇情講述王識賢飾演才氣縱橫而心高氣傲，且心中似乎隱藏著什麼大秘密的「木工修復師」，該戲探討如何藉由這項逐漸沒落的工藝修補眾人的羈絆，再創台灣傳統文化的價值，也將體現台灣小鎮濃厚的人情味。平凡寫實的小人物故事、真摯的情感，絕對令人又哭又笑！

programme.title: 包青天第120集
programme.desc: 包拯為北宋仁宗天聖五年（1027年）申科進士甲科，初任建昌知縣，官至開封府尹及龍圖閣大學士，這跟電視上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中國清官的典型代表，後世包括朱熹、歐陽修、司馬光對他都有正面評價。宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱「包青天」。為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調「人在做天在看」、「舉頭三尺有神明」不畏強權，除惡務盡。較膾炙人口的單元有「秦香蓮」、「真假狀元」、「貍貓換太子」等。

programme.title: 真情部落格第783集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 福氣人生第269集
programme.desc: 要擁有福氣人生，可以透過聆聽牧師們以台語分享聖經的真理，讓你領受天國滿滿的福氣與祝福。這些牧師們將以深入淺出的方式解釋聖經，將其應用於當代生活，讓你明白神的心意和計劃。通過聆聽台語講道，你可以更深入地理解聖經的教導，並在日常生活中實踐。這些講道將提供實際的指引和智慧，幫助你在家庭、工作、人際關係等各個領域經歷神的福氣。聆聽這樣的講道，你將能夠領悟到屬天的價值觀和生活方式，學習依靠聖靈的帶領，活出基督徒的身份和見證。這將使你能夠更深入地體驗神的愛和恩典，並將其傳遞給他人。

programme.title: 恩典365第1608集
programme.desc: 跟隨寇紹恩牧師，每天五分鐘，領受上帝的話語，並將其應用到實際生活中。這樣我們可以每天都在上帝的愛和恩典中浸泡。

programme.title: 經典音樂河第133集
programme.desc: 節目中除了膾炙人口的聖詩演唱和演奏外，還有旁白將詩歌背後的故事和歌詞意境生動地道出來。同時，精彩的台灣大自然景觀影片作為背景，為觀眾帶來視覺上的享受。節目的目標是在聽覺、視覺和心靈層面上陪伴觀眾，在他們每一天的生活中營造美好的時光。

programme.desc: 福音短片，每天三分鐘，能夠重新激發您的力量並蒙受祝福！這些短片以生活化的例證，幫助朋友們更深入地認識耶穌！讓您在忙碌的生活中，用短短三分鐘，與福音相連，並與耶穌建立更親密的關係！

programme.title: 真情部落格第781集
programme.desc: 自2005年開播以來，《真情部落格》已訪問數百位生命勇士。當這些勇士面對生命中的困難時，他們選擇依靠對耶穌的信心，勇敢地克服挑戰。這些可愛的基督徒願意與大家分享他們生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是將來自天上的美好福分帶給人們。每一個充滿血淚的生命見證都是令人震撼的轉變，帶來最深刻的真實感。

programme.title: 頌泉心靈醫治特會第17集
programme.desc: 《頌泉心靈醫治特會》是一個專注於心靈健康和醫治的特殊活動，通過音樂、詩歌、靈修、分享等方式，營造正面愛與希望的氛圍，幫助參與者釋放壓力、找到內在平靜，並尋求心靈上的慰藉和醫治。

programme.title: 與天使有約第3集
programme.desc: 天使蒙妮卡的使命是將上帝的指示和消息傳給處於人生十字路口的各種人。

programme.title: ila部落住一晚第2季:第21集
programme.desc: 透過二天一夜的部落生活，感受族人的熱情，分享部落美好的人事物，認識並欣賞原住民各族文化之美，提供觀眾只有原鄉部落才有的深度體驗之旅，真實感受在地生活的幸福與美好。

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第313集
programme.desc: 暗夜客話新聞是全國唯一主播、記者以全客語發音的新聞頻道，並 詳實顯示字幕，除了著眼於「客家觀點」的重要新聞議題、呈現客家生活 習俗與傳統文化之外，更盡力發掘社會各階層客家鄉親的故事。暗夜客話新聞針對四節新聞播出鏡面，以桐花、藍衫等各種不同主題的客家元素為基礎，作全面的視覺設計，讓收視大眾們能夠耳目一新、零時差的掌握，最具客家觀點的新聞呈現。

programme.title: 【客家尋味劇場】台北歌手第5集
programme.desc: 男高音、小說家和劇作家於一身，戰後，甚至提起武器參與反抗行動，36歲的呂赫若正值大展風華才氣之際，卻不幸死於非命，作為台灣文學史上的風雲人物，客家電視台將重新打造呂赫若的生平與其作品改編為連續劇，嘗試探索才子傳奇的一生。

programme.title: 客家新聞雜誌第1022集
programme.desc: 由陳美禎主持，以客家人的觀點，結合時事和近期舉辦的各種客家活動，做詳盡而深入的各種專題探討和介紹。

programme.title: 福氣來了第77集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等專案。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 後生大聲公第86集
programme.desc: 節目邀請18~25歲的客家年輕人，聊聊對客家、對教育、對媒體、對社會議題的看法。

programme.title: 日頭下‧月光光第107集
programme.desc: 此齣為與生活資訊結合的客家戲劇，客語口說藝術的劇場，其中包含了相聲竹板快書、以及說文解字，用活潑逗趣的表演方式，來傳達客家語言，敬請觀眾鎖定收看！

programme.title: 國際新聞-客觀世界第306集
programme.desc: 是一個專注於國際時事的新聞節目，以客觀、中立的角度報導全球各地的重要新聞事件。節目內容涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的議題，旨在向觀眾傳遞真實可信的消息，讓觀眾全面瞭解世界各地的動態，增進對國際事務的理解和視野。

programme.title: 停動停動好健康第257集
programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 地球隊好麻吉第3集
programme.desc: 你知道大自然有多少神奇的模樣嗎？帶你一起出發找答案！每一集，我們會到四個不同國家，和世界各地的小朋友一起發現風、花、大樹、河流的秘密，讓你成為最懂地球的好麻吉，守護我們住的美麗星球！

programme.title: 恐龍大牧場 III第3集
programme.desc: 在這片自然優美、作物豐富的大西部土地上，卡西迪家族與恐龍夥伴們共同經營著牧場，過著既忙碌又充滿驚喜的生活。無論是訓練恐龍、追查野生迅猛龍的足跡，還是保護珍貴的月光百合花，孩子們與恐龍總能在挑戰中成長，在合作中找到解答。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1161集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 客家新聞雜誌第1022集
programme.desc: 由陳美禎主持，以客家人的觀點，結合時事和近期舉辦的各種客家活動，做詳盡而深入的各種專題探討和介紹。

programme.title: 福氣來了第77集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等專案。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 一家之煮第476集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾瞭解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第6集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(海陸腔)第20集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(海陸腔)第196集
programme.desc: 「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」是一個關於四位好朋友的故事，他們相聚在一起時，總是充滿著對話、爭吵和歡笑。

programme.title: 吉日良辰客家封第20集
programme.desc: 以一道道料理為起點，透過食材的生產關係、食物的料理過程乃至廚師的烹飪目的，《吉日良辰客家封》試著以人與料理的故事，建立與客家概念的連結與對照，勾勒客家飲食多元豐富的面向。

programme.title: 當晝新聞第314集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 飛越客莊第27集
programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客莊的人文風情和自然景觀。這套裝置擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客莊所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第20集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 麻吉樂園LINE TOWN第4集
programme.desc: 一個無奇不有的溫馨小鎮「LINE TOWN」，鎮上住著許多歡樂、開心的LINE卡通明星：沉默溫和的熊大、開朗時髦的兔兔、隨心所欲的饅頭人、自戀的詹姆士、愛漂亮的潔西卡、常常幫大家解決事情的莎莉、以及害羞內向的雷納德等人，在LINE TOWN發生了一連串有趣的大小事。

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所單歌第73集
programme.desc: 我們邀請了許多專業的音樂家和創作者擔任所長，他們將帶給您最好的音樂和創作心情。這個節目的目的是讓您在睡前能夠享受美妙的歌聲，讓一整天的緊繃情緒都能夠釋放出來。此外，我們還會不時地分享一些有關音樂的小知識，讓您對音樂有更深入的瞭解。

programme.desc: 《停動停動好健康》是一個關注身體健康的節目，通過介紹和推廣健康的生活方式和運動方法，鼓勵觀眾在日常生活中停下腳步，注重運動和健康飲食，增進身體健康和心靈幸福，提高生活質量。這個節目旨在激發觀眾對健康的關注和重視，讓人們更好地照顧自己的身心健康。

programme.title: 奧林p客第1636集
programme.desc: 在新的對話中，主持人和機器人阿藍妹將增加科技互動的元素。參賽孩子們將扮演小博士的角色，從各種主題和發明中學習現代科學和未來科技。每一集將以「一大六小」的競賽形式進行，並引入四選一的卡牌抽選機制，讓孩子們學習團隊合作，並在面對不同意見時學會溝通和做出抉擇。

programme.title: 恐龍大牧場 III第4集
programme.desc: 在這片自然優美、作物豐富的大西部土地上，卡西迪家族與恐龍夥伴們共同經營著牧場，過著既忙碌又充滿驚喜的生活。無論是訓練恐龍、追查野生迅猛龍的足跡，還是保護珍貴的月光百合花，孩子們與恐龍總能在挑戰中成長，在合作中找到解答。

programme.title: 客家戲曲第1162集
programme.desc: 由多個著名客家劇團，分別演出相當膾炙人口的小說故事，希望能讓大家再次回味童年看戲的滋味，也能讓更多人欣賞到客家的傳統大戲。

programme.title: 村民大會-過家尞聊正事第117集
programme.desc: 打造一台行動雜貨店，駛入客莊大街小巷，歡迎鄉親一起來喝茶聊天，暢談地方議題，大人小孩都來「過家尞聊正事」，關心客莊大小事！

programme.title: 福氣來了第78集
programme.desc: 為一民生消費資訊的訪談性節目，邀請知名中西醫療專家、營養師，為鄉親解惑；更結合運動養身，教學瑜珈、太極和律動等專案。同時，也會介紹客莊各地的活動、農特產品、表演團體等，要給觀眾們滿滿的一朝晨。

programme.title: 一家之煮第477集
programme.desc: 走訪客莊邀請兩組家庭進行對決，藉由家人間的默契一起做料理，品嚐彼此完成的美食，進而帶領觀眾瞭解「感動人」的客家文化及地方特色食材或時令蔬果。

programme.title: 學學嘴學學鼻MV時間第7集
programme.desc: 孩子牙牙學語的模樣，是所有父母最鮮明的親子時光，而我們客家人有一個詞，生動描述了這個過程：「學嘴學鼻」。全新推出的幼兒節目《學學嘴學學鼻》，就是從這四個字延伸而來的創意。我們塑造了兩位默劇小丑，逆向操作了大人教孩子的邏輯，反過來用畫面外的孩子，一字一句教小丑說客語，小丑則會搭配幽默逗趣的肢體語言，呈現每集要學習的關鍵字。

programme.title: 森林偵探隊Ⅲ(大埔腔)第20集
programme.desc: 延續前兩季故事走向，除了阿皮牯外，更額外增加了新的冒險夥伴阿莉、阿新牯、卡卡。面對接踵而來的森林任務，大家勇敢、熱心且不畏艱難地向彼此伸出援手，儘管過程中充滿挑戰，卻也能在每次的行動中獲得意想不到的收穫

programme.title: ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕(大埔腔)第196集
programme.desc: 朋友聚在一起時，總是會有對話、爭吵、歡笑，以及許多有趣的故事。這個節目「ㄤ牯ㄤ牯咕咕咕」，描述的就是四個好朋友間的種種經歷和冒險故事。

programme.title: 懂吃懂吃來煮食第18集
programme.desc: 踏上歡愉的旅程，烹煮出暖心的滋味！

programme.title: 當晝新聞第315集
programme.desc: 《當晝新聞》是一個日間新聞節目，提供即時、全面的國內外新聞報導，涵蓋政治、經濟、社會、文化等多方面的重要議題。這個節目專注於在白天時段向觀眾傳遞當下最重要的新聞資訊，讓觀眾隨時掌握時事動向，並對眾多議題保持關注和理解。無論是政治動盪、經濟變化，或者社會事件和文化創新，這個節目都將為觀眾帶來最及時的報導和解析。

programme.title: 飛越客莊第28集
programme.desc: 藉助一套先進的高機動無人機裝置，我們能夠輕鬆模擬飛鳥俯瞰的視角，以優雅的姿態穿梭於繁華的街道和幽靜的小巷，完整紀錄下台灣客莊的人文風情和自然景觀。這套裝置擁有各種變幻莫測的攝影角度，能夠生動地呈現客莊所發生的故事，並以獨特的視角展現現代客家文化的發展脈絡。

programme.title: 【客家尋味劇場】台北歌手第6集
programme.desc: 男高音、小說家和劇作家於一身，戰後，甚至提起武器參與反抗行動，36歲的呂赫若正值大展風華才氣之際，卻不幸死於非命，作為台灣文學史上的風雲人物，客家電視台將重新打造呂赫若的生平與其作品改編為連續劇，嘗試探索才子傳奇的一生。

programme.title: 福氣來了(南方篇)第118集
programme.desc: 《福氣來了 南方篇》將延伸至中南部及花東地區，透過節目提供平台，讓鄉親朋友能夠走進攝影棚，分享他們的故事，並進行互相交流。在東南部的客家莊裡，我們能夠欣賞到獨特的生活方式，美麗如畫的田園風光以及多元的文化。讓我們在這個地方，暢談鄉親們的人生故事。

programme.title: 大自然生趣第21集
programme.desc: 你知道台灣原生的鹿科動物總共有幾種嗎？你知道留鳥與夏候鳥的差別嗎？你知道「南路鷹一萬死九千」這句話的由來嗎？你知道有哪些鳥是父親負責孵蛋跟照顧小孩呢？ 請共下來瞭解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思來說，是自然界中生生不息的各種生物所帶來的許多趣味。很湊巧的，「生趣」這兩個字，其實這是客語「有趣」的發音，因此換成客語來說，就是「大自然真有趣」。這個節目是將客籍生態紀錄片導演劉燕明先生三十餘年來上山下海，辛苦拍攝所得的豐富生態影像，以每集5分鐘之短篇製作成有趣又具生態教育意義的短片，具有兩大特色：1.生態專業團隊製作：導演劉燕明先生與撰稿、旁白的鄧慶煜先生，兩人皆具備生態與紀錄片拍

programme.title: 暗夜新聞第315集

programme.title: 暢歌實驗所單歌第74集
programme.desc: 我們邀請了許多專業的音樂家和創作者擔任所長，他們將帶給您最好的音樂和創作心情。這個節目的目的是讓您在睡前能夠享受美妙的歌聲，讓一整天的緊繃情緒都能夠釋放出來。此外，我們還會不時地分享一些有關音樂的小知識，讓您對音樂有更深入的瞭解。

programme.title: 溜麵線雜貨店第37集

programme.desc: 故事從龍隊14年來主力重炮手柳澤博人開始；柳澤博人自球員生涯開始，就是場上耀眼焦點，直到近年陷入低潮挫折，博人因壓力而常在鎂光燈下流露負面情緒，又再接到球團不續約通知後，人生更是跌落低谷深淵，就當自己都泛起放棄的念頭時，一通求助電話，反而燃起博人對棒球的熱情，也更發現，真正的棒球，不是隻有強力揮擊而已…

programme.title: 探索新境第2季:第1集

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:第12集
programme.desc: 英國摩根汽車公司出產新一代三輪車，它的車架是用木材製造的，搭配兩公升引擎，各項組裝都是由人工裝配，並且用防水皮革打造內裝。印度BS成衣公司生產用竹棉做成的衣服，這種布料抗菌、快乾又除臭，會在織布機中加入彈性纖維以增加耐用度，並進行染色、剪裁、縫紉，就能製作成各式各樣的衣服。土耳其的維特拉工廠每年生產超過五百萬個馬桶，其原料是礦物、石英、長石和瓷土，由氧化鋁球研磨混合物並過濾，再將泥漿灌入模具烘烤，冷卻上釉後即完成。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第3季:第2集
programme.desc: 這集的河中巨怪中，傑瑞米韋德前往巴布亞紐幾內亞，這個以吃人肉、異教儀式、獵人頭及激烈部落衝突聞名的國度，搜尋一種會攻擊男性生殖器的河中水怪。剛抵達巴紐時，由於當地自然環境特殊，他已可預知這趟搜尋河怪的任務不會順利，尤其是因為當地居民對外人充滿極度的不信任，傑瑞米第一次嘗試釣魚時，便發生漁線被咬斷的事，接著因為有人表示前不久才遭鱷魚攻擊，因此他一度懷疑咬斷男性生殖器的事否可能為鱷魚，很快推翻此假設後他重新展開追查，後來他釣到一條淡水鯧魚，由於淡水鯧魚屬草食性，因此他當下便排除對此魚的懷疑，然而經過幾番折騰，他發現由於環境的改變，淡水鯧魚已由草食性轉變為同時具肉食特質的魚種，加上先前遇襲的人的解釋

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:第11集
programme.desc: 本集生活科技大解密介紹鑄鐵柴火火爐、木藍染料以及電子合成器。鑄鐵柴火火爐由富蘭克林於1741年發明，擁有良好的加熱效果，不僅能讓室內保暖，還能用來烹調食物，這種火爐要如何製造呢？藍色是世界上最受歡迎的顏色，而木藍這種植物數千年來都用來提煉藍色染料，牛頓更以其名字命名彩虹中的靛藍色，木藍染料要如何製造呢？電子樂在現今流行音樂中扮演重要的角色，而想要演奏電子樂就要靠電子合成器的幫助，電子合成器是如何製造的呢？

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第14季:第12集
programme.desc: 英國摩根汽車公司出產新一代三輪車，它的車架是用木材製造的，搭配兩公升引擎，各項組裝都是由人工裝配，並且用防水皮革打造內裝。印度BS成衣公司生產用竹棉做成的衣服，這種布料抗菌、快乾又除臭，會在織布機中加入彈性纖維以增加耐用度，並進行染色、剪裁、縫紉，就能製作成各式各樣的衣服。土耳其的維特拉工廠每年生產超過五百萬個馬桶，其原料是礦物、石英、長石和瓷土，由氧化鋁球研磨混合物並過濾，再將泥漿灌入模具烘烤，冷卻上釉後即完成。

programme.title: 工程大突破第5季:第5集
programme.desc: 近年來由於氣候變遷，雨量漸少，世界各地旱象頻傳，澳洲也不例外，為瞭解決水資源不足的問題，澳洲政府斥資35億美元，在墨爾本郊外的威廉森海灘，興建南半球最大的海水淡化廠，這項重大的基礎建設將能解決墨爾本的水荒問題，未來市民的飲用水將不虞匱乏。這項工程動員3500名工作人員，從開挖海底隧道，在海底安裝升管吸取海水，再到安裝全球最大的逆滲透架，用高科技的脫鹽裝置，有效去除海水中的鹽分，再到運用附近電廠的電力，進行海水淡化作業，除了要克服種種工業建設方面的困難，建築師還非常注重生態環保，這個濱海的海水淡化廠，也將是美觀的永續建築。

programme.title: 河中巨怪第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 這集的河中巨怪中，傑洛米韋德前往日本，調查日本民間的一些恐怖傳說，此趟日本行讓他覺得異常辛苦，因為日本民間有許多這類傳說，尤其每個人的說法都不盡相同，因此讓他難以判斷，然而抽絲剝繭後，他鎖定兩個方向追查兩種河中巨怪，一是會引發地震的地震鯰，另一個則是會擄走並殺害孩童的河怪河童，地震鯰的傳說是說地底有隻巨鯰，一移動身軀便會引發地震，由於常理判斷鯰魚不可能真的長得如此巨大，因此傑洛米認為是鯰魚的行為模式會於地震發生前出現變化，請教矢田教授後確定了鯰魚的這種特性，等於驗證了地震鯰的傳說；接著傑洛米開始追查河童，日本民間對河童的傳說，讓此河怪看來像是結合了多種動物，然而追查過程中，傑洛米卻判斷某些細節

programme.title: 戰痘醫師第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 67歲的丹尼斯，頭頂長了好幾顆囊腫，尤其是後腦杓那顆特別大，大到讓他連安全帽都戴不下去，因此斷送他騎車的樂趣。由於他不喜歡看醫生，在老婆唐娜的積極要求下，他去找李醫師幫忙，終於解決了他多年來的困擾，整個人重獲新生，唐娜也很開心找回了老公。

programme.title: 戰痘醫師第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 前集李醫師發現大衛眼下不尋常的腫塊，本集揭曉為基底細胞癌，得進行莫氏手術切除，這次久未見面的女兒陪同，也讓兩人關係修復；妮可的脖子滿是腫塊，外人總是不敢接近，曾看診卻成效不彰，十年來嚴重影響自信，經李醫師確診為皮脂腺囊瘤，立即進行手術切除，然而手術比妮可想像的還痛，但為了自己她還是選擇熬過去，最終還給她平坦美麗的脖子；史帝夫的額頭上長了雞蛋般的脂肪瘤，已多年無法戴帽子，這次他下定決心要將之切除，成為當初老婆愛上的自己；艾倫手臂上的腫瘤已二十年，然而對醫療的恐懼和朋友的慘痛醫療經驗讓他一再推拖，直到未婚妻鼓勵才肯看診，但一上手術台還是焦慮不堪，李醫師甚至覺得無法動手術，他究竟是否能克服心理障礙呢

programme.title: 管教惡貓第8季:第5集
programme.desc: 洛杉磯的動物收容所貓滿為患，而且每況愈下。當民間的收容所容量已達飽和時，許多幼貓就被送到市立收容所。由於幼貓需要大量的心力照顧，市立收容所沒有人力支援，因此假如幼貓沒有人認養就會被安樂死。然而洛杉磯根本沒有足夠的家庭可認養或收養這些貓咪，結果造大量無辜的幼貓面臨死亡命運。好友動物協會發起洛杉磯不殺生運動，從市立收容所拯救出50隻幼貓，將牠們送到收養家庭照顧到健康的八週，並完成疫苗注射和絕育手術。現在好友動物協會請求傑克森的協助，希望他有人脈能幫助這50隻幼貓找到認養的人家。

programme.title: 小動物狠角色第1季:第11集
programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是馬達加斯加雨林裡的低地馬島條紋蝟。牠可說是地球上最特別的哺乳動物了，低地馬島條紋蝟的屁股上有一小搓又粗又短的尖刺，互相敲擊的時候會發出人類聽不見的高頻率聲波，藉此把消息傳遍整座雨林，和其他低地馬島條紋蝟進行溝通。

programme.title: 小動物狠角色第1季:第12集
programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是墨西哥的刺尾鬣蜥。嬌小的刺尾鬣蜥光是外觀就很威風，牠有一條長滿尖刺的尾巴，只要被牠的尾巴甩到，肯定會濺血，但奇妙的是如此威風的小鬣蜥居然是草食動物，牠最愛的食物就是荊棘林裡的闊葉植物了。

programme.title: 小動物狠角色第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是來自泰國的飛蜥。這種古老的爬蟲類已經在地球上存活2.5億年，牠們演化出了不起的滑翔能力，垂直爬樹的速度更是迅雷不及掩耳。牠們最喜歡的棲地是雨林中的橡膠樹園，裡面有許多牠們愛吃的昆蟲，還可以在樹林間自由地飛來飛去。

programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有讓人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是來自馬達加斯加的古氏鼠狐猴。牠們是地球上最嬌小的靈長類動物，不過牠們非常罕見，直到14年前才有一位美籍科學家發現這些鼠狐猴的存在。牠們有驚人的跳躍能力，加速度更是驚人，在樹叢中穿梭的身影就像一顆黃色的毛球閃電。

programme.title: 小動物狠角色第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是來自泰國的飛蜥。這種古老的爬蟲類已經在地球上存活2.5億年，牠們演化出了不起的滑翔能力，垂直爬樹的速度更是迅雷不及掩耳。牠們最喜歡的棲地是雨林中的橡膠樹園，裡面有許多牠們愛吃的昆蟲，還可以在樹林間自由地飛來飛去。

programme.title: 動物百分百第3季:第8集
programme.desc: 甲殼類是數量龐大的一群生物，至少有5萬個物種，屬於節肢動物門。

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第3季:第9集
programme.desc: 傑夫醫生帶著獸醫團隊重返墨西哥，這是他每年都會安排的旅程，為墨西哥的偏鄉地區從事免費獸醫服務，而且這次他的團隊甚至前往從未踏足過的地區。因為墨西哥的貧苦人家連自己都可能養不起，更遑論將貓狗寵物送去做絕育手術。但貓狗的繁殖力非常強，當飼主養不起而棄養時，就會造成嚴重的流浪貓狗問題。傑夫醫生的策略就是帶領一群當地醫生，在短時間內完成大量的貓狗20個絕育手術，這樣才能有效地降低對當地的流浪貓狗數量。一群認同傑夫醫生的墨西哥獸醫，長期加入這個活動，共同為墨西哥的偏鄉獸醫服務盡一份力。

programme.title: 走出首爾-南韓的自然奇觀第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 南韓偏遠島嶼與濕地孕育獨特自然與人文風景，居民靠農漁維生、傳承技藝。

programme.title: 百變水族箱第8季:第14集
programme.desc: 野火肆虐加州索諾馬郡，火災波及森林、農場、住家，造成人、畜傷亡和流離失所。科丁鎮購物中心想打造一個大水族箱，將被野火焚毀的社群地標—紅穀倉永遠保留在水族箱裡，同時放入受野火摧毀嚴重的當地物種—赤杉，以及逃過焚毀命運的LOVE雕塑。以這個水族箱紀念購物中心的創始人，同時向火災發生時，英勇的的緊急應變人員與消防員致敬。

programme.title: 小動物狠角色第1季:第15集

programme.title: 小動物狠角色第1季:第16集
programme.desc: 嬌小的動物雖然不太起眼，但有些狠角色卻擁有令人大開眼界的超強能力。本集節目要介紹的是泰國的亞洲臭鼩。牠的外觀看起來就像老鼠，走起路來也像老鼠，但牠卻是罕見的有毒哺乳類，牠的毒液可以讓獵物麻痺癱瘓，一被牠抓到就沒有逃命的機會；此外，牠急速轉彎的速度和角度，就連羚羊都望塵莫及，簡直就是棕櫚樹林中的彎道女王。

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第5集

programme.title: 管教惡貓第8季:第6集
programme.desc: 這集的管教惡貓中，傑克森蓋勒克西在送養一些幼貓後，持續追蹤幼貓在新家的適應狀況，但節目剛開始，他要先去關心一對戀人和他們領養的一隻貓咪間的問題，到了飼主家後，他發現問題很嚴重，但不是貓的問題，而是人的問題，因為男主人有嚴重的貓咪恐懼症，且男女主人間充滿恐懼、愚昧、焦慮，甚至欺瞞，他甚至覺得他們根本不該找貓咪專家來協助，所幸在他的細心指導下，問題終究順利解決；接著傑克森去探視一隻鼻子先天不健全的幼貓摩喜多，他特別心疼摩喜多，不巧領養摩喜多的飼主似乎對牠有些疑慮，所幸在傑克森的指導下，問題迎刃而解，飼主家人除了開心地重新接納摩喜多外，更進一步另外多領養一隻幼貓；此外，傑克森還去探視另一個領養兩隻幼

programme.title: Ben 10 再顯神威第109集
programme.desc: 《BEN10：再顯神威》劇情回到十歲男孩田小班意外地發現外星手錶Omnitrix的起點，這神奇的手錶竟然可以讓原本平凡的小班擁有變身成外星英雄的能力！更厲害的是，每一個外星英雄都有獨特又酷炫的超能力！小班、小玟和馬克爺爺祖孫三人一起踏上冒險旅程，打擊外星壞蛋！但小班身負更大的責任，就是千萬不可以變錯外星英雄、用錯超能力，才能所向無敵！

programme.title: 飛天小女警第103集
programme.desc: 小鎮村本來是一個平凡的小鎮，可是自從遺傳學家尤教授來到鎮上以後，這個平凡的小鎮就搖身一變成為一個的舉世矚目的地方，尤教授希望可以運用科學方法，創造出世界上最完美的小女孩，他將蜜糖和香料等各種甜美的材料混在一起，不過他不小心將神秘的化學原素X也給加了進去，結果就創造出三個模樣可愛，嫉惡如仇、誓與罪犯周旋到底的飛天小女警。

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第22集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶、太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶。 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型、甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星。兔寶寶、太菲鴨、傻大鳥、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼。 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界。

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第10集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著一個住在平凡城鎮、卻一點也不平凡的搞怪家庭。這個家庭的成員包括終日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉紅兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工廠上班的媽媽陶春嬌。他們的孩子也很有特色，有藍色大頭貓阿甘和4歲天才小兔安安，以及原本是寵物金魚、長了兩條腿後就變成家庭成員之一的阿達。

programme.title: 機甲猛鬥第7集
programme.desc: 在往學校的路上，孟鬥遇上了被一群稱作錐筒兵的不良機器人在馬路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞車。錐筒兵喜愛建造，但是脾氣很糟，於是當孟鬥指責他們時，他們合體成為一個叫做超級錐筒兵的大機器人攻擊孟鬥。運用機甲球的機甲化能力，孟鬥擊敗了錐筒兵，但孟鬥並沒有送他們進監牢，而是同意如果他們將造成的破壞修復，並保證不會再犯，就可以放他們自由。

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝第323集
programme.desc: 音樂是一種世界語言，當你在一個語言不通的地方，拿起樂器來哼唱幾句，就能快速連結彼此的心。對於正處於語言能力疾速發展的兒童，接觸音樂更能和 語言學習相輔相成。已有多項研究證明，讓發育中的幼兒接觸樂器，可以刺激腦部神經，增進創造力，加強耐心及專注力。

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go第1386集

programme.title: 豆豆先生第117集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金(Rowan Atkinson)，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位、讓鄰居安靜下來、換沙發或是曬曬太陽等。豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出。這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映。

programme.title: 金厲害潛水艇第122集
programme.desc: 年輕天真的海豚金厲害帶領一艘裝滿魚兒和海水的另類潛水艇，打算前往他們夢寐以求，具有純淨水源的陸地~拉斯維加斯。但這段奇葩的海陸大冒險沿途總是波折不斷，有時內憂有時外患，一點也不平靜…

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝第323集
programme.desc: 音樂是一種世界語言，當你在一個語言不通的地方，拿起樂器來哼唱幾句，就能快速連結彼此的心。對於正處於語言能力疾速發展的兒童，接觸音樂更能和 語言學習相輔相成。已有多項研究證明，讓發育中的幼兒接觸樂器，可以刺激腦部神經，增進創造力，加強耐心及專注力。

programme.title: 機甲猛鬥第29集
programme.desc: 在往學校的路上，孟鬥遇上了被一群稱作錐筒兵的不良機器人在馬路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞車。錐筒兵喜愛建造，但是脾氣很糟，於是當孟鬥指責他們時，他們合體成為一個叫做超級錐筒兵的大機器人攻擊孟鬥。運用機甲球的機甲化能力，孟鬥擊敗了錐筒兵，但孟鬥並沒有送他們進監牢，而是同意如果他們將造成的破壞修復，並保證不會再犯，就可以放他們自由。

programme.title: 熊熊寶貝遇見你第12集
programme.desc: 《熊熊遇見你》全新衍伸作品《熊熊寶貝遇見你》將跟著（小寶寶時期的）大大、胖達，以及阿極展開冒險，透過神奇魔法盒，他們穿梭來到如夢似幻的新世界，踏上尋覓容身之處的旅途，希望找尋彼此心中所認可的那個「家」。旅途中他們結識了一些新朋友，也學習了一些新知，他們這才意識到其實只要彼此在一起，無論哪裡都可以是彼此認定的「家」。大大寶貝、胖達寶貝和阿極寶貝尋找新家的過程非常艱辛，還被原本的房東趕了出去!他們很希望能夠有一個屬於自己的家。這時候，他們的箱子上出現了一顆星星，把三隻小熊帶到了仙子們居住的美麗森林。這裡會不會就是他們期盼已久的新家呢?

programme.title: 豆豆先生第112集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金(Rowan Atkinson)，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位、讓鄰居安靜下來、換沙發或是曬曬太陽等。豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出。這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映。

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝第323集
programme.desc: 音樂是一種世界語言，當你在一個語言不通的地方，拿起樂器來哼唱幾句，就能快速連結彼此的心。對於正處於語言能力疾速發展的兒童，接觸音樂更能和 語言學習相輔相成。已有多項研究證明，讓發育中的幼兒接觸樂器，可以刺激腦部神經，增進創造力，加強耐心及專注力。

programme.title: 探險活寶-支線任務第17集
programme.desc: 一個呆呆的小男孩阿寶，一條充滿智慧的老狗老皮，他們成了拍檔，一同探索哇賽秘境獨特又有趣的奇幻世界。他們彼此相互幫助，度過危險與困境，一起享受歡樂的時光與感動的時刻。

programme.title: 飛天小女警第104集

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第24集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶、太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶。 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型、甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星。兔寶寶、太菲鴨、傻大鳥、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼。 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界。

programme.title: 阿甘妙世界第11集
programme.desc: 故事圍繞著一個住在平凡城鎮、卻一點也不平凡的搞怪家庭。這個家庭的成員包括終日待在家中的家庭主「夫」、身高六呎四寸的粉紅兔爸爸陶大知，以及在彩虹工廠上班的媽媽陶春嬌。他們的孩子也很有特色，有藍色大頭貓阿甘和4歲天才小兔安安，以及原本是寵物金魚、長了兩條腿後就變成家庭成員之一的阿達。

programme.title: 機甲猛鬥第8集
programme.desc: 在往學校的路上，孟鬥遇上了被一群稱作錐筒兵的不良機器人在馬路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞車。錐筒兵喜愛建造，但是脾氣很糟，於是當孟鬥指責他們時，他們合體成為一個叫做超級錐筒兵的大機器人攻擊孟鬥。運用機甲球的機甲化能力，孟鬥擊敗了錐筒兵，但孟鬥並沒有送他們進監牢，而是同意如果他們將造成的破壞修復，並保證不會再犯，就可以放他們自由。

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝第324集
programme.desc: 音樂是一種世界語言，當你在一個語言不通的地方，拿起樂器來哼唱幾句，就能快速連結彼此的心。對於正處於語言能力疾速發展的兒童，接觸音樂更能和 語言學習相輔相成。已有多項研究證明，讓發育中的幼兒接觸樂器，可以刺激腦部神經，增進創造力，加強耐心及專注力。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第118集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金(Rowan Atkinson)，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位、讓鄰居安靜下來、換沙發或是曬曬太陽等。豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出。這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映。

programme.title: 金厲害潛水艇第106集
programme.desc: 年輕天真的海豚金厲害帶領一艘裝滿魚兒和海水的另類潛水艇，打算前往他們夢寐以求，具有純淨水源的陸地~拉斯維加斯。但這段奇葩的海陸大冒險沿途總是波折不斷，有時內憂有時外患，一點也不平靜…

programme.title: 金厲害潛水艇第109集

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝第324集
programme.desc: 音樂是一種世界語言，當你在一個語言不通的地方，拿起樂器來哼唱幾句，就能快速連結彼此的心。對於正處於語言能力疾速發展的兒童，接觸音樂更能和 語言學習相輔相成。已有多項研究證明，讓發育中的幼兒接觸樂器，可以刺激腦部神經，增進創造力，加強耐心及專注力。

programme.title: 機甲猛鬥第30集
programme.desc: 在往學校的路上，孟鬥遇上了被一群稱作錐筒兵的不良機器人在馬路中央建造游泳池而造成大塞車。錐筒兵喜愛建造，但是脾氣很糟，於是當孟鬥指責他們時，他們合體成為一個叫做超級錐筒兵的大機器人攻擊孟鬥。運用機甲球的機甲化能力，孟鬥擊敗了錐筒兵，但孟鬥並沒有送他們進監牢，而是同意如果他們將造成的破壞修復，並保證不會再犯，就可以放他們自由。
